text_block_list.name: Junior Club Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, another personal best?! That's incredible, Tsurumaru-san!
And you only just joined our club!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna shave off eeeven more!
I'm a future Triple Crown horsegirl, after all!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you've got talent, you gotta polish it!
I'm gonna work even, even... harderer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...?! *yawn*... Ngh—
...Ah, 3 AM again...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My meeting with Trainer isn't until noon.
Today... I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I might as well make good use of this time, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow marks the start of one-on-one training with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
I hum to myself as I put together a training regimen for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I wryly chuckle at myself for getting so ahead of myself.
Deciding it was finally time to sleep, I pick up my smartphone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I dive under the covers in a hurry. The alarm is set.
All that's left is to close my eyes and...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Without getting a single wink of sleep, morning had arrived.
The air on the morning track is nice and crisp...
choice_data_list: (I was so keyed up, I couldn't sleep at all...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hahh, hehh... augh... whoaaa-aaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... mmhh... huh?
Huh... a bed...? Where am I—... Wait, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, I had her examined, but she had no fever and nothing unusual turned up.
When I asked why she had been so dizzy and wobbling, she replied—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry!!
It's just that I woke up really early this morning, so...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd squeeze in fifty laps for a warm-up...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Auuugh~, guess so~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But my legs are totally warmed up now!
How about we hit the track right this second! I can sprint at full power from here—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-I just tripped over my own foot!
I'm fine! Totally fine! I even broke my fall properly!
choice_data_list: No, no, that's really not the point...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah~?! Please don't look so worried.
I really am okay! Honest!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No fever, and my legs don't hurt at all.
So let's get out there and hit the perimeter track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Normally, I should send her right back to rest. But leaving her like this doesn't sit right with me either.
A reasonable compromise would be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up taking her to a ramen joint near the academy.
If we talk about what's next over a meal, it should help calm her down.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—! I see, nutrition is crucial for an athlete!
Calories and nutrients are directly tied to building our bodies, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Now is the time to show my grit. ...Tsuyoshi will push her stomach to its absolute limits!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Chef! Give me the Mega-Sized Special Heap Bowl!
Make that enough for ten horsegirls, pleeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Tsuru-chan has an upset stomach and is resting today~.
choice_data_list: Ah... yeah... thanks for letting me know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Also, I was entrusted with a letter for you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
She said, 'Next time, I'll expand my stomach capacity so I can clean the bowl.
I've already come up with a strategy for it'~.
choice_data_list: ...? Well, let me have a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the envelope handed to me by Mejiro Bright.
The very first line reads: 'Tsuyoshi's Grand 10-Bowl Ramen Strategy!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rest was written in wobbly, shaky handwriting.
'1. Eat more meat regularly' '2. Ask the regulars for tips'

text_block_list.name: Letter from Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
'3. Become someone who can eat to her heart's content!'
'4. Grow into a girl who will surprise Trainer!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the list went on, the points sounded less like strategies and more like enthusiastic resolutions.
Yet every single one of them reflected Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's boundless optimism—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I trace my finger over the fierce passion hidden beneath the feeble, scribbled handwriting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Tsuru-chan puts her absolute all into everything she does.
choice_data_list: Yeah... it really seems that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Is she groaning in bed right now, racking her brains all by herself to find a way forward?
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: ...I have to give it my all too!
...I need to work even harder too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I can't let her do all the trying alone.
Even if it's only provisional, I'm still her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... indeed, you are.
Please be sure to share those feelings with Lady Tsuru-chan directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And may I make one small request of my own as well...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Zzz... zzz...*
Mmh... mmgh...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Cough, wheeze!* *Hack, gasp!* 
Uwahhh, fever again... Guess I gotta skip the club today...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—B-But I can still study races at home!
I can watch footage and read books! I'm fine, there's always something I can work on!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. Even if my legs hurt, I can still stretch my shoulders!
I'll make 'em super flexy... and totally surprise the coaches~♪

text_block_list.name: Youth Club Coach
text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru! How is your body feeling—

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan! Everyone's times are posted over there!
Wanna go check 'em out together?!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Sorry Coach, let's talk later!
Ummm, my time is—

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Dead last.
...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Well, duh! Of course it is!!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone else was working hard too!
Besides, I... I haven't worked nearly as hard as they have!
